## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by the Tang court official [徐鍔](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%90%E9%8D%94) Xú È is an *account* (*shù* 述) of the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa T0310](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)*, paralleling the imperial preface by *Tàishànghuáng* [睿宗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9D%BF%E5%AE%97) Ruìzōng. Xú È provides further documentary detail on the translation enterprise of [菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97) Bodhiruci and the institutional setting of the work.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (706 – 720) reflects the period during which Xú È served as a Tang court official and was associated with the Bodhiruci translation team.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X264) collection.
